_comment: The accepted gaps in the Playwright suite, checked by scripts/skip-budget.mjs after every CI run.
A skip is not a pass: this file is what makes that visible rather than implied.
Lower maxSkipped whenever a gate is unblocked (2026-09-20: the pgvector service in the e2e job moved
the four PostgreSQL-gated tests into the run).

recorded.note: 26 before the e2e job gained a pgvector service; 4 PostgreSQL-gated tests (3 datastore-pg, 1 epic proof 3) now run. The cap keeps two slots of slack so a runner difference does not turn the job red, and lowering it is the next step as the remaining gates are unblocked.

forbidden.why: The e2e job runs a pgvector/pgvector:pg17 service and sets KILASFLOW_E2E_POSTGRES_DSN, so this reason means the service, the DSN or the connection is broken — the datastore half of the suite would otherwise be missing while the job stayed green.
